hold_text: Held on the operator's own pacing decision, DEC-20260916-PACING-RULES, recorded in docs/claude/work/objects/WO-20260916-OPERATOR-DIRECTION.yaml and restated verbatim in this lane's spawn prompt: "At 8 units you stop and report, whatever state you are in. You do not continue. You do not decide the remaining work is small enough to just finish." This lane reached that cap. The DIFF is Tier-1 on its own terms -- research tooling (scripts/research/), two test/research requirements files, regenerated evidence records under comms/, and two backlog rows -- and nothing here touches src/, config/, an order path, a strategy parameter or any manager register, so it would otherwise be self-landing. It is held because the instruction to stop and report is not conditional on the remaining work being small, which is exactly the reasoning the decision forbids. A manager or a later session should land it; nothing about the change is waiting on an approval or on an observation.
why: MI-287. All 23 harness_failed records in comms/strategy_evidence/ carried one error class -- `RuntimeError: yfinance returned no rows for <TICKER>` -- which read as 23 broken harnesses and was one data-fetch failure reproduced 23 times. CAUSE MEASURED 2026-09-16, not inferred: Yahoo answers a plain-`requests` User-Agent with HTTP 429 ('Edge: Too Many Requests') and serves the byte-identical request with a browser UA -- 429 in 6 of 6 default-UA attempts against 200 in 6 of 6 browser-UA attempts, interleaved in one loop against the same host and ticker. The library-level discriminator, same machine and same minute: yfinance 0.2.40 returned 0 rows for SPY, GDX and ES=F while yfinance 1.7.0 returned 365 / 365 / 302 (the 0.2.x line builds its session on `requests`; the 1.x line uses curl_cffi to impersonate a browser). POSITIVE CONTROL for egress: data.binance.vision returns 200, and it is the feed the 19 already-`measured` legs use -- so this was never a sandbox block and never absent data. Both requirements files pinned only `yfinance>=0.2.0`, a floor that admits the broken resolution, and that floor is what cost 23 of 52 legs. THE FIX IS TWO PARTS. (1) The floor is raised to >=1.7.0 in requirements-backtest.txt and requirements-test.txt, with the measurement recorded inline so a later reader does not have to re-derive it -- and stated honestly as NOT MINIMAL: 1.7.0 is the lowest version MEASURED to work, not the lowest that does work, because the boundary was not bisected. (2) scripts/research/regime_debt_matrix.py's yahoo arm no longer collapses two opposite states into one message. `yfinance returned no rows for {ticker}` was true both when the venue refused US (remedy: our dependency) and when the venue has no rows for THIS ticker (remedy: the symbol or the window), and that collapse is why the whole class read as 23 harness faults. The new message runs a SPY positive control on an empty frame and reports venue_state=refusing_us / serving / undetermined -- never folding a control that itself raised into either answer -- and names the installed yfinance version. RESULT, census over all 52 records: measured 19 -> 41, harness_failed 23 -> 1, no_harness 10 -> 10. 22 of 23 recovered. THE ONE RESIDUAL IS NOT THIS CLASS AND THE NEW DISCRIMINATOR IS WHAT ESTABLISHED THAT: splg_trend_long_1d now reads `venue_state=serving -- the SPY control returned 5 rows, so the venue is up and this is specific to SPLG`, confirmed independently on the raw API (SPLG returns HTTP 200 with a populated meta block and NO timestamp array at range=1y, and meta.firstTradeDate is 2026-07-14). Filed, not fixed, as BL-20260916-SPLG-YAHOO-SERVES-NO-1Y-DAILY-BARS-SO-ONE-EVIDENCE-LEG-STAYS-UNMEASURED. The wider gap -- ~20 other yfinance importers keep the same unguarded shape, an empty frame read as an empty market, with nothing detecting the venue refusing the fleet -- is filed as BL-20260916-TWENTY-SCRIPTS-IMPORT-YFINANCE-AND-NOTHING-DETECTS-THE-VENUE-REFUSING-THE-WHOLE-FLEET. NOT IN SCOPE AND NOT TOUCHED: the 10 no_harness legs (a missing regime_debt_matrix.classify() branch, a different problem), any strategy geometry (DEC-20260916-E35-GEOMETRY is operator-settled; atr_stop_mult stays 2.0 on all 9 e35 legs), and every manager register.
